notes: All shares are FIXED CONSTANTS (end-use split priors). They are deliberately parameterized here (not hardcoded) so the modeling workstream (DEV-alternative iterations, e.g. regression on LL84 fuels + heating-degree disaggregation) can replace them wholesale without touching pipeline logic. Each constant cites its source. These are priors, NOT per-building fits — no invented precision: every modeled output carries an evidence tier and 'model:additive-end-use-split' method tag.

heating_efficiency.unit: fraction of fuel site energy delivered as heat
heating_efficiency.source: typical non-condensing gas boiler/hot water system annual fuel utilization; assumption documented, NOT measured per building

cooling_cop.unit: COP for delivered cooling per kWh of electric chiller/AC input
cooling_cop.source: typical commercial central plant COP; assumption documented, NOT measured per building

gas_split_by_archetype._note: What share of a property's metered natural gas goes to SPACE HEATING vs DHW. Chosen, conservative single-source splits per building type; flagged as FIXED PRIOR not regressed. Explicitly intended to be replaced by per-borough regression work (DEV-159 follow-up).

office.source: CBECS 2018 end-use fuel tables show natural gas dominates space heating (~3/4) and DWH (~2/3) nationally; office-heavy gas = heating-dominated. Directional, cited, parameterized.

multifamily.source: NYC multifamily gas profile literature (e.g. NYSERDA multifamily retrofit reports): space heating largest; DHW plus small cooking residual second. Cooking folded into DHW bucket; documented so the split stays a clean partition (sums to 1.0).

other.source: blend toward CBECS mixed-commercial heating-dominated profile; used for retail/education/health/public-assembly flesh-passes

elec_split_by_archetype._note: What share of metered grid-purchase ELECTRICITY (kWh) goes to COOLING (converted via COP). Remaining elec shares (lighting/plug/etc.) intentionally NOT disaggregated in v1 — only cooling is an end-use output; others stay as 'other_elec'.

office.source: CBECS 2018 electricity end-use by building type: office cooling ~25% of office electricity; cycle overlaps with EIA's `electricity shares of office cooling`

multifamily.source: CBECS multifamily/residential-mixed cooling fraction of electricity; NYC multifamily has in-window/in-unit AC, not central plant — 25% used as renewable/upper-bound prior, parameterized

other.source: CBECS mixed-prototype; ballpark close to office; parameterized

archetype_by_pluto_landuse._source: MapPLUTO landuse code (1-11) -> archetype bucket; documented mapping, deterministic
archetype_by_pluto_landuse._note: Emergency/vacant/parks use 'other'; iterating finer (Nursing/Hotel/Mixed-Use) is follow-up modeling work.

evidence_tiers.T1_observed_full: LL84 match present AND site EUI + GFA + at least one fuel observed (gas or elec). End-uses derived from observed fuels with explicit share constants.
evidence_tiers.T2_intensity_only: LL84 match present with EUI or GFA but BOTH gas and elec missing/zero. Site energy estimated as EUI x GFA, end-uses from archetype fuel-split priors only.
evidence_tiers.T3_archetype_prior: No LL84 match (or EUI missing). Site energy and all end-uses come from archetype intensity priors — flagged clearly, not comparable to observed tiers.
evidence_tiers.T4_footprint_numeric_only: Feature has footprint geometry but only footprint-derived attributes; area + null energy. Treated as null, NOT zero.

limits_and_caveats: No invented confidence intervals: outputs carry evidence tier + method tag, not a CI.
Missing inputs produce null end-uses, never zero.
Campus/parent-child disaggregation is allocation-based (area-weighted), carried as flags disagg/ disagg_weight/ disagg_n from build_pilot.py; conservation checks vs LL84 property aggregates.
Site EUI out of physical plausibility (>9999 kBtu/ft2, e.g. data-entry outliers) kept as OBSERVED but flagged desc_outlier; not silently winsorized.
